scope: P1/P2: 13 modules, six complementary tuples, 78 individually viewed static captures; not the full Cartesian product.

font_provenance.purpose: Explicit test-only fallback; not shipped or evidence of native automatic fallback.
font_provenance.copyright_source: Font name table, name ID 0; both font licenses are retained beside assets.

corrections.problem: RTL changed 1 / 12 into the visual order 12 / 1.
corrections.fix: Explicit LTR for the numeric page indicator.

corrections.problem: RTL moved signs after numeric diff counts.
corrections.fix: Explicit LTR for each signed count, keeping the surrounding RTL order.

corrections.problem: RTL coding metadata reordered signed additions and deletions.
corrections.fix: Explicit LTR on the coding count RichText; preserved the separate performance fix.

corrections.problem: An unequal matching / total ratio was reversed in an Arabic paragraph.
corrections.fix: LRI/PDI isolates only the numeric ratio in RTL; localized prefix and plain semantic label remain unchanged.

runs.scope: new first nine + Approval + Tool + Thinking + Thinking long trace
final new ten + Filter widget + Filter semantics

focused_validation.overlap_note: Nine new cases overlap between the two runs; totals must not be summed as unique tests.
focused_validation.analysis: No issues in new Dart review helpers, fixtures, exporter target and focused tests.

limits: The tuples cover each requested dimension but do not execute every combination of locale, theme, width, text scale, motion and component state.

The Noto fallbacks are test-only fonts with retained OFL licenses, loaded explicitly after Geist. No Apple font is copied or distributed. Native automatic font fallback is not accepted by these captures.
Static reduced/none/platform-disabled images do not prove temporal animation, hover, press, focus, native editing, assistive technology or frame performance.
Dynamic state evidence here consists of the ten specified focused tests plus separately maintained existing tests; those states are not claimed to appear in all 78 captures.
The earlier 49-image review remains tied to its original source snapshot. These images are complementary; corrected RTL numeric behavior is accepted only by this new evidence.
Viewport width is not forced component width. Components keep their own width caps and text-scale adaptations.
Native device, browser input, screen-reader and performance acceptance are separate workstreams and are not marked complete here.
